collier.normalization: Native UV=i*pi^2*UV; finite=i*pi^2*(tensor-(EulerGamma+log(pi))*UV); IR slots zero only in this qualified massive IR-finite domain. Independent UV checks B0=i*pi^2, rank1=-i*pi^2*p1/2, triangleUV0.
